goal: Render true template-driven Word numbering and styled list paragraphs without changing ListInstruction.
non_goals: Do not change Markdown parsing, Domain Model, Compiler or RenderPlan.
Do not add picture bullets, checkboxes or cross-block numbering continuation.
expected_evidence: numbering.xml format, marker, start, alignment and indentation assertions
document.xml numPr and paragraph style assertions
unsafe_assumptions: Paragraph style application order does not affect run-level font and emphasis output.
stop_condition: Stop if rendering requires Markdown parsing, school constants or Word objects outside the DOCX Renderer.
